question: For email lists with names starting with e (case insensitive), containing 10 to 20 members inclusive, and where over 75% are computer science students, provide the list name, owner, and member count.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "mailing_lists" AS SELECT "moira_list_key" AS "moira_list_key", "moira_list_name" AS "moira_list_name", "is_moira_mailing_list" AS "is_moira_mailing_list", "is_active" AS "is_active" FROM beaver."moira_list";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "mailing_list_owners" AS SELECT "moira_list_owner_key" AS "moira_list_owner_key", "owner" AS "owner", "owner_type" AS "owner_type" FROM beaver."moira_list_owner";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "mailing_list_members" AS SELECT "moira_list_key" AS "moira_list_key", "moira_list_owner_key" AS "moira_list_owner_key", "moira_list_member" AS "moira_list_member", "moira_list_member_full_name" AS "moira_list_member_full_name", "moira_list_member_mit_id" AS "moira_list_member_mit_id" FROM beaver."moira_list_detail";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "student_directory" AS SELECT "email_address" AS "email_address", "department" AS "department", "department_name" AS "department_name", "student_year" AS "student_year" FROM beaver."mit_student_directory";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base_lists AS (
    SELECT ml.moira_list_key, ml.moira_list_name
    FROM mailing_lists ml
    WHERE COALESCE(ml.is_moira_mailing_list,'N') = 'Y'
      AND COALESCE(ml.is_active,'N') = 'Y'
      AND LOWER(TRIM(ml.moira_list_name)) LIKE 'e%'
),
member_rows AS (
    SELECT m.moira_list_key,
           TRIM(LOWER(m.moira_list_member)) AS member_key,
           m.moira_list_member_mit_id
    FROM mailing_list_members m
    WHERE m.moira_list_key IN (SELECT moira_list_key FROM base_lists)
),
-- Derive a contact key to match to student directory: prefer email in member, else map MIT ID via employee_directory if needed (not available here),
-- so we will match by email when member_key contains '@'. Otherwise, we cannot confirm student major; those count as non-CS for the share denominator.
member_emails AS (
    SELECT moira_list_key,
           CASE WHEN member_key LIKE '%@%'
                THEN member_key
                ELSE NULL END AS email_address
    FROM member_rows
),
student_flags AS (
    SELECT me.moira_list_key,
           CASE WHEN sd.department_name ILIKE '%computer science%'
                 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_cs_student,
           1 AS is_matched_student
    FROM member_emails me
    JOIN student_directory sd
      ON LOWER(sd.email_address) = me.email_address
),
agg AS (
    SELECT bl.moira_list_key,
           bl.moira_list_name,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE me.email_address IS NOT NULL) AS email_members,
           COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
           COALESCE(SUM(sf.is_cs_student),0) AS cs_students,
           COALESCE(SUM(sf.is_matched_student),0) AS matched_students
    FROM base_lists bl
    LEFT JOIN member_emails me ON bl.moira_list_key = me.moira_list_key
    LEFT JOIN student_flags sf ON bl.moira_list_key = sf.moira_list_key
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
-- Member count: use distinct member rows irrespective of email match (proxy for size)
member_counts AS (
    SELECT moira_list_key, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member_rows
    GROUP BY 1
),
owner_lookup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.moira_list_key, o.owner AS owner
    FROM mailing_list_members m
    JOIN mailing_list_owners o ON m.moira_list_owner_key = o.moira_list_owner_key
)
SELECT a.moira_list_name AS list_name,
       ol.owner AS owner,
       mc.member_count
FROM agg a
JOIN member_counts mc USING (moira_list_key)
LEFT JOIN owner_lookup ol USING (moira_list_key)
WHERE mc.member_count BETWEEN 10 AND 20
  AND CASE WHEN mc.member_count > 0 THEN (a.cs_students::DOUBLE) / (mc.member_count::DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END > 0.75
ORDER BY mc.member_count DESC, list_name
LIMIT 50

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "mailing_lists" AS SELECT
  TRIM(moira_list_key) AS moira_list_key,
  LOWER(TRIM(moira_list_name)) AS moira_list_name,
  COALESCE(TRIM(is_moira_mailing_list),'N') AS is_moira_mailing_list,
  COALESCE(TRIM(is_active),'N') AS is_active
FROM beaver."MOIRA_LIST"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "mailing_list_owners" AS SELECT
  TRIM(moira_list_owner_key) AS moira_list_owner_key,
  TRIM(owner) AS owner,
  TRIM(owner_type) AS owner_type
FROM beaver."MOIRA_LIST_OWNER"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "mailing_list_members" AS SELECT
  TRIM(moira_list_key) AS moira_list_key,
  TRIM(moira_list_owner_key) AS moira_list_owner_key,
  TRIM(moira_list_member) AS moira_list_member,
  TRIM(moira_list_member_full_name) AS moira_list_member_full_name,
  CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(moira_list_member_mit_id AS VARCHAR)),'') AS VARCHAR) AS moira_list_member_mit_id
FROM beaver."MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "student_directory" AS SELECT
  LOWER(TRIM(email_address)) AS email_address,
  TRIM(department) AS department,
  TRIM(department_name) AS department_name,
  TRIM(student_year) AS student_year
FROM beaver."MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "employee_directory" AS SELECT
  CAST(mit_id AS VARCHAR) AS mit_id,
  LOWER(TRIM(email_address)) AS email_address,
  LOWER(TRIM(krb_name)) AS krb_name,
  UPPER(TRIM(krb_name_uppercase)) AS krb_name_uppercase,
  TRIM(department_name) AS department_name
FROM beaver."EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base_lists AS (
  SELECT moira_list_key, moira_list_name
  FROM mailing_lists
  WHERE COALESCE(is_moira_mailing_list,'N')='Y'
    AND COALESCE(is_active,'N')='Y'
    AND LOWER(TRIM(moira_list_name)) LIKE 'e%'
),
member_rows AS (
  SELECT m.moira_list_key,
         TRIM(LOWER(m.moira_list_member)) AS member_key,
         m.moira_list_member_mit_id AS mit_id
  FROM mailing_list_members m
  WHERE m.moira_list_key IN (SELECT moira_list_key FROM base_lists)
),
-- Derive possible identifiers
ident AS (
  SELECT moira_list_key,
         member_key,
         CASE WHEN member_key LIKE '%@%'
              THEN member_key ELSE NULL END AS email_key,
         CASE WHEN member_key NOT LIKE '%@%'
              THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(member_key,'[^a-z0-9]','') ELSE NULL END AS krb_key,
         CASE WHEN mit_id IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(mit_id AS BIGINT) ELSE NULL END AS mit_id_key
  FROM member_rows
),
-- Match to student_directory via email
sd_match AS (
  SELECT i.moira_list_key,
         1 AS is_student_row,
         CASE WHEN LOWER(sd.department_name) ILIKE '%computer science%' OR LOWER(sd.department_name) ILIKE '%eecs%'
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_cs
  FROM ident i
  JOIN student_directory sd
    ON LOWER(sd.email_address) = i.email_key
),
-- Match to employee_directory via email, kerberos, or MIT ID
ed_from_email AS (
  SELECT i.moira_list_key,
         1 AS is_student_row,
         CASE WHEN LOWER(ed.department_name) ILIKE '%computer science%' OR LOWER(ed.department_name) ILIKE '%eecs%'
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_cs
  FROM ident i
  JOIN employee_directory ed
    ON LOWER(ed.email_address) = i.email_key
),
ed_from_krb AS (
  SELECT i.moira_list_key,
         1 AS is_student_row,
         CASE WHEN LOWER(ed.department_name) ILIKE '%computer science%' OR LOWER(ed.department_name) ILIKE '%eecs%'
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_cs
  FROM ident i
  JOIN employee_directory ed
    ON LOWER(ed.krb_name) = i.krb_key OR ed.krb_name_uppercase = UPPER(i.krb_key)
),
ed_from_mitid AS (
  SELECT i.moira_list_key,
         1 AS is_student_row,
         CASE WHEN LOWER(ed.department_name) ILIKE '%computer science%' OR LOWER(ed.department_name) ILIKE '%eecs%'
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_cs
  FROM ident i
  JOIN employee_directory ed
    ON ed.mit_id = i.mit_id_key
),
all_matches AS (
  SELECT * FROM sd_match
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ed_from_email
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ed_from_krb
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ed_from_mitid
),
collapsed AS (
  SELECT moira_list_key,
         SUM(is_student_row) AS matched_rows,
         SUM(is_cs) AS cs_rows
  FROM all_matches
  GROUP BY 1
),
member_counts AS (
  SELECT moira_list_key, COUNT(*) AS member_count
  FROM member_rows
  GROUP BY 1
),
owner_lookup AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.moira_list_key, o.owner AS owner
  FROM mailing_list_members m
  JOIN mailing_list_owners o ON m.moira_list_owner_key = o.moira_list_owner_key
)
SELECT bl.moira_list_name AS list_name,
       ol.owner AS owner,
       mc.member_count
FROM base_lists bl
JOIN member_counts mc USING (moira_list_key)
LEFT JOIN collapsed c USING (moira_list_key)
LEFT JOIN owner_lookup ol USING (moira_list_key)
WHERE mc.member_count BETWEEN 10 AND 20
  AND CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.matched_rows,0) > 0 THEN (c.cs_rows::DOUBLE)/(c.matched_rows::DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END > 0.75
ORDER BY mc.member_count DESC, list_name
LIMIT 50

WITH base_lists AS (
  SELECT moira_list_key,
         TRIM(LOWER(moira_list_name)) AS list_name,

SELECT c.list_name,
